# Dark Souls Font

Brings a Dark Souls-inspired font into League of Legends.

This mod supports English, Latin characters, Cyrillic, and Greek. Other Unicode scripts, including CJK and Arabic, are not supported and may fall back to League’s default font.

Got an idea for another Mod or UI specific Wish? Send recommendations! I’m always looking for fun new ones to make.
